description:
Stored analyses for the MockAIProvider, keyed by copy_hash. Invented copy and invented interpretations; no real advertiser, no model output, no performance claim of any kind.

The keys are REAL copy_hash digests, computed from tests/fixtures/ad_provider/corpus.json with the production normaliser and services.copy_hash.copy_hash_v1. They were placeholders before, which could never be stored -- ad_analysis.copy_hash requires 64 lowercase hex -- so every lookup missed and the mock returned its all-null analysis. Derive them with tests/corpus_hashes.corpus_copy_hash(ad_id); never hand-write one.

b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.hook: Opens by naming a failure the reader has already had: a kettle that stops whistling.
b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.problem: Kettles that fail within a year, leaving the reader with an appliance that looks fine and silently does not.
b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.promise: A kettle still in working order after years of daily use.
b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.offer: A 5,000 boil-cycle test claim, with the test log published rather than summarised.
b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.persona: Household buyers who have replaced the same small appliance before.
b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.pain_point: Cheap goods that fail quietly, with no way to check.
b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.angle: Specificity as proof: a large number plus a published method, instead of a quality adjective.
b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.proof: A stated cycle count and a published test log, linked from the ad itself.
b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.awareness_level: Problem-aware. The reader knows the category and the failure mode; the ad does not need to explain either.
b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.funnel_stage: Consideration. It supplies evidence for a purchase already being weighed up.
b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.copy_structure: Open on the familiar failure, name the specific number, offer the log as proof, close on a purchase action.
b62dc7a3e20d0dc0661c89f14fb38797fb538876.why_it_may_work: It replaces an unverifiable quality claim with a number and a method a reader could check, which suits readers who are already tired of unverifiable quality claims. Whether it does is not something the copy itself can show.

96b6a5bb699117b86635268e195925b73f156901.hook: Names the three plants in the headline itself, before any body copy runs.
96b6a5bb699117b86635268e195925b73f156901.problem: Ayurvedic products whose ingredient lists are hard to find, buried on a back label.
96b6a5bb699117b86635268e195925b73f156901.promise: The ingredients are stated up front, on the front of the pack.
96b6a5bb699117b86635268e195925b73f156901.persona: Readers who buy herbal products and have wanted to see the full ingredient list before ordering.
96b6a5bb699117b86635268e195925b73f156901.pain_point: Ingredient lists that are present but effectively hidden.
96b6a5bb699117b86635268e195925b73f156901.angle: Disclosure as the product claim: the thing competitors treat as a legal detail is made the headline.
96b6a5bb699117b86635268e195925b73f156901.proof: The ad states the list is printed on the front of the pack.
96b6a5bb699117b86635268e195925b73f156901.awareness_level: Product-aware. The reader knows what haritaki or ashwagandha is; the ad is not teaching the category.
96b6a5bb699117b86635268e195925b73f156901.funnel_stage: Consideration, leaning to purchase. The reader has a product in mind and is deciding between brands.
96b6a5bb699117b86635268e195925b73f156901.copy_structure: Ingredients listed as a headline, the disclosure decision explained in the body, an action to close.
96b6a5bb699117b86635268e195925b73f156901.why_it_may_work: Leading with the disclosure rather than a benefit claim reads as the opposite of the category's habit, and that contrast may be what a reader who has been disappointed by that habit notices. It is a reading of the wording, not an observation about what the ad achieved.
